description.value: Rigger's is a pub on Savary Island, a small, largely car-free island in the Strait of Georgia accessible by water taxi from Powell River. As one of the few food and drink establishments on the island, it serves as a natural gathering point for visitors arriving by boat, kayak, or bicycle. The remote island setting makes any resupply stop here a notable waypoint for touring cyclists exploring BC's Sunshine Coast.
